product.name: Monoprice Commercial Series Portrait and Landscape Rotating 360 Degree Low Profile Fixed TV Wall Mount Bracket - For LED Displays 37in to 80in Max Weight 110 lbs. VESA Patterns up to 600x400
product.description: This mount bracket is designed to mount a flat‑panel TV in the portrait or landscape orientation. It is compatible with TVs with a VESA® mounting pattern between 200x200 and 600x400 (400x600 in portrait orientation), which includes most 37" to 80" TVs*.The included hardware supports mounting on brick and concrete walls. The mount can safely hold up to 110 pounds (including the weight of the mount itself).*Note that the display screen size is only an approximation. Your display is compatible with this mount as long as it has a VESA® mounting pattern and weight that fit within the size and weight limits listed above.Support Files: User's Manual (Mar 16, 2021)Monoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc. VESA® is a trademark owned by the Video Electronics Standards Association (VESA®) in the United States and other countries. UL® and the UL logo are registered trademarks of UL LLC.
